purpose: Review automation execution outcomes across a shared workspace date range, optionally narrowed by rule and status.
primaryGoal: Find an execution, understand its outcome and action results, and inspect associated vehicle state transitions.

dataSources.behavior: 25 rows per server page; limit/offset/status/since/until; rule ID selects the per-rule endpoint rather than an unsupported global automation_id query parameter. Query key includes all scope inputs, forwards cancellation signal and polls at INTERVALS.STANDARD. assertHistoryPage rejects malformed envelopes rather than converting failed data into empty history.
dataSources.sourceTrust: Items, total, summary and trend arrive in one envelope. Handler supplies the same filter to ListAll/GetStats/GetTrend. A failure in any of those operations fails the envelope; independent successful aggregates are not separately available.
dataSources.limitations: Repository SQL implementation and live responses were not inspected/exercised. Per-rule endpoint checks rule existence and returns 404 for a missing rule.

dataSources.owner: automation API and existing safeArray query selector
dataSources.behavior: Separate polling query supplies rule names/options. Page retains a Rule #id option when URL selection is not in the loaded rules. Its error/retry is independent of history.
dataSources.limitations: List route registration confirmed; list-handler implementation and safeArray implementation not audited.

dataSources.behavior: Enabled only for non-null selected execution ID; ID-specific query key, cancellation signal, STALE_TIMES.STANDARD. Detail is not polled by this hook.
dataSources.sourceTrust: Record is authoritative execution history. FSM transitions are fetched for its vehicle and execution window, capped at 100. Backend normalizes missing transitions and transition-query failure to an empty array, and returns 200 for the record. Detail success_rate is unfiltered per-rule history and is not currently displayed.

dataSources.owner: Existing workspace header/range preference and URL state
dataSources.behavior: Page passes startInstant and endInstantExclusive directly as since/until. Route is registered for header-owned range; /automations prefix disables header vehicle scope. No competing local date or vehicle picker.

components.name: PageLayout
components.usage: Page heading/subtitle, copy link and navigation CTA; full-width min-w-0 container delegates shell behavior to PageContainer.

components.name: AutomationHistorySummary / OperationalBrief
components.usage: Six operational metrics, full-filter scope, provenance/freshness explanation and retained-summary status through useOperationalMetrics.

components.name: AutomationHistoryTrend / ChartContainer
components.usage: Success/failed/other period buckets; shared tooltip, legend, accessible fallback data table and chart export pipeline. Stable chartKey automation-history-trend.

components.name: AutomationHistoryTable / DataTable
components.usage: Seven columns; stable automations:history ID, compact density, column visibility/reorder/resize persistence, default loaded-row export pipeline.

components.name: AutomationExecutionDetail / Modal
components.usage: Selected execution metadata, optional error, action-result JSON and FSM transitions; existing modal close and scroll behavior.

components.name: Select, Pagination, Button, Text, PanelTitle, GlassPanel
components.usage: Rule/status filtering, caller-owned page navigation, detail-opening action, typography and surfaces.

components.name: QueryError, Skeleton, EmptyState, StaleRefreshWarning, DataStateNotice
components.usage: Initial failure/retry, contextual loading, empty navigation and retained-data warning.

components.name: DateTime / useNumberFormatting
components.usage: User-context timestamps and specialist duration formatting; implementations not inspected.

components.name: FadeIn
components.usage: Three section entrances; source uses existing motion preference and removes delay/reveal initial state when reduction is requested.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: New-automation Link hand-copies neutral button chrome rather than composing existing BUTTON_BASE/BUTTON_VARIANTS; focus and shape can drift.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing navigation-button styling while retaining Link semantics and /automations/new destination.

sourceStrategy: PageLayout uses w-full/min-w-0 container; filters use flex-wrap; panel padding increases at sm.
Table mobile allow-list is rule/status. Other five columns are hidden below md by DataTable; rule action opens detail exposing timestamp, trigger, action counts, duration and error.
Detail metadata stacks then becomes two columns at sm; JSON supports wrapping/local horizontal scroll; Modal is bottom-aligned below sm with constrained body scrolling.
Pagination source uses container-dependent controls, 44px mobile buttons, page counts and a direct-jump form.

issues.detail: Filter flex-1/w-full/min-w-0/sm:max-w classes are passed to Select's inner native select, while its outer div is the actual flex item. Intended filter reflow/allocated widths are not guaranteed.
issues.fix: Apply allocation classes on page-owned wrapper elements around Select and retain localized accessible labels; test narrow containers and long rule names.

issues.detail: Triggered time is hidden below 768px. Rows of the same rule/outcome have identical visible information and detail-opening names; users must open each record to identify when it occurred. All seven column values remain obtainable from the detail, so this is not a claim of total data loss.
issues.fix: Use the existing mobilePresentation contract or a deliberate compact identity cell including trigger time; preserve full metadata/detail access and loaded export scope.

responsive.requiredChecks: 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560 widths, allocated container widths, 200% text, long rule names/errors and open detail; all unverified.

positiveSourceEvidence: Localized Select aria-labels and decorative icon aria-hidden on page.
Named DataTable caption; chart ariaLabel and supplied data/dataColumns fallback.
Modal source has role=dialog, aria-modal and title association; shared close control is 44px. Focus trapping/restoration helper implementation not inspected.
Text statuses accompany outcomes; color is not their only representation. DateTime uses existing user context.
FadeIn reads shared reduced-motion preference; real OS/low-bandwidth behavior not exercised.

issues.detail: Detail-opening button overrides height/padding to content size; its accessible name is only the rule name. Minimum target spacing and distinguishability between executions require review.
issues.fix: Retain ghost appearance with an adequate touch target and localized execution-specific name including timestamp; do not replace the real rule label.

issues.detail: Navigation CTA specifies min-h-9 rather than 44px and no shared focus-ring classes. Select defaults to min-h-10. Actual spacing exception, computed target sizes and browser focus visibility are unverified.
issues.fix: Reuse shared link chrome and mobile target sizing; make filter targets at least the shared mobile default without altering selection behavior.

accessibility.evidenceLimits: No keyboard, screen-reader, effective contrast, forced-colors, focus restoration or browser interaction tests.

states.initialLoading: History rows show four skeletons; summary and trend retain their own loading surfaces. Detail shows h-48 skeleton.
states.empty: No matching rows explains period/filters and offers Manage automation rules; trend offers the same destination. Summary keeps zero counts but treats rate/duration as undefined when no completed runs.
states.fatalError: History, rules and detail expose retryable QueryError independently; summary and trend reuse history fatal error without hiding other page sections.
states.refreshError: Retained rows/rules/detail remain rendered with StaleRefreshWarning. Summary status becomes Retained execution summary. Trend keeps retained points using fatalError rather than raw query.error.
states.offline: Shared useDataState distinguishes paused refresh with retained data; StaleRefreshWarning renders offline explanation. Cold/offline initial request behavior not runtime verified.
states.unknownUnavailable: Missing summary renders unavailable notice; missing detail renders unavailable plus retry. Missing durations/trigger/errors use dash rather than zero.
states.partial: Execution status partial is preserved as a business outcome; it is not the same as a partially unavailable data source.

issues.detail: Trend derives DataState but only passes loading/fatalError to ChartContainer. Its own retained-state/freshness notice is absent; the history-source warning appears later in the table panel.
issues.fix: Attach existing StaleRefreshWarning and/or ChartContainer source metadata adjacent to trend; preserve retained points and independent retry.

issues.detail: FSM transition subsection disappears for an empty array. Backend supplies the same [] for no vehicle, no transitions and failed transition lookup; results are capped at 100 without truncation metadata. The UI cannot truthfully distinguish these states from the current envelope.
issues.fix: Keep transition-section identity with a neutral unavailable/no-results explanation; do not assert no transitions occurred. Integration owner should expose availability/failure and bounded-result metadata before stronger trust claims.

visualIssues.detail: Three fixed hex fills define a feature-local success/failed/other chart palette. No glow/neon classes were found in the five assigned source files, but composed appearance/contrast is unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Consume existing semantic/chart palette tokens without changing series identities, aggregation or saved legend state.

visualIssues.detail: Error text uses fixed text-rose-300 rather than shared error typography/semantic tokens; light-theme contrast is unknown.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing error typography/semantic color contract and preserve the complete error text.

architectureIssues.detail: Table receives a server-paged slice but not DataTable.paginationControls; page renders Pagination separately. DataTable therefore treats default search/export as loaded-row operations, not full server-range operations. Existing export description correctly labels loaded scope, which must not be silently upgraded.
architectureIssues.fix: Consider supplying existing paginationControls and variant=embedded within the page panel to unify table/footer ownership. Preserve page URL semantics and explicitly retain loaded-page search/export scope unless backend full-result support is separately authorized.

priority.rationale: Already uses modern layout, operational metrics, typed hooks, server bounds and retained-data handling. Prioritize filter allocation/mobile execution identity and per-source trust; no evidence supports a wholesale rewrite.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Execution-detail FSM source availability and bounded-result metadata
requiredSharedChanges.concreteContract: An integration-owned additive typed availability result distinguishing unavailable/no vehicle, successful empty, successful populated and lookup failure, plus whether the 100-result cap truncated the window. Retain existing record and fsm_transitions payload; exact API shape must be agreed by its owner.
dependsOn: existing FSM repository bounded-query contract, not inspected
requiredSharedChanges.classification: integration contract requirement, not a proposed new shared UI composite

competingImplementations.detail: Local navigation CTA styling competes with existing shared Button link-chrome constants; reuse rather than add another component.
Feature-local hardcoded chart palette competes with centralized chart colors.

sections.name: Execution summary
sections.preserve: Six metrics: completed runs, succeeded, failed, partial, success rate, average duration; scope, source context, freshness and unavailable fallback.

sections.name: Execution activity
sections.preserve: Full-range server trend, success/failed/other groups, resolution by bucket count, sorted periods, legend persistence, chart fallback table and image exports.

sections.name: Filtered execution history
sections.preserve: Rule/status options, independent rules trust, seven columns, detail action, table preferences, loaded exports, 25-row server paging and all loading/error/empty states.

sections.name: Execution details overlay
sections.preserve: Six metadata fields, optional full error, optional action JSON results and optional state transitions; independent trust, retry and dismissal.

actions: Copy page link via PageLayout copyLink; underlying PageContainer behavior not exercised.
Navigate to /automations/new; navigate to /automations/list from empty rows/chart.
Select rule or one of running/success/partial/failed/skipped/cancelled/test/undo outcomes; URL replace preserves other parameters and resets page for non-page filter changes.
Navigate server pages, first/last/previous/next/direct jump through shared Pagination; page count clamps and updates invalid high page.
Open execution by rule button and close detail via Modal; selected ID remains local rather than adding a URL state.
Retry history, rule list and detail independently; stale warning offers retained-source refresh.
Table column visibility/reorder/resize persistence and default CSV/JSON loaded-row exports through shared DataTable, not full-range exports.
Trend legend hide/show via stable chartKey and shared image export menu. No fullscreen prop or exportData supplied; do not claim current fullscreen or chart CSV capability.
Inspect complete action-result JSON and timestamped FSM transitions.
dataBehavior: Retain typed raw payload, URL parameter names, query keys, polling intervals, cancellation signal and ID enablement.
Keep both instant range bounds server-side for rows/summary/trend; preserve timezone/rolling URL preference semantics from shared hook.
Fleet/workflow route intentionally has no global vehicle selector; do not introduce a duplicate.
Summary counts/rate come from server, not loaded-row calculations. No-runs rate and average remain undefined rather than measured zero.
Duration milliseconds remain raw on existing API; summary conversion to seconds is display adaptation only. Do not undertake wire/schema unit changes in a page modernization.
Trend groups success, failed and every other status; period prefixes switch daily/monthly/yearly at existing thresholds 730/3650 rows.
Null history rows become [] only after validated successful envelope; retained data is never discarded merely for a refresh error.
Keep rule ID fallback for URL-selected rules missing from rules list; per-rule missing-rule 404 remains a real error.
Detail records carry additional snapshots/conditions/vehicle/completion fields not currently presented. Audit does not invent these as existing visible sections or remove them from wire/cache.

evidenceLimits.mode: Read-only source audit; no source changes, Git, nested agents, production mutations, browser use, lint/build/TypeScript or test suite.
evidenceLimits.scope: Assigned mounted page and four narrow feature dependencies, scoped shared implementation ranges, hook/type/route and history-handler source only.
